files.name: pcb/macropad-gerbers.zip
files.detail: Gerbers and drill files; our DRC, at least as strict as JLCPCB's, PCBWay's, OSH Park's and Aisler's 2-layer limits: 0 errors, every net connected, and the read-back (gerbonara and shapely on the zip and the netlist) finds the nets design.json means, and its self-test catches each fault put in; the board's firmware, run on that copper, types each key's code, and its self-test catches each wiring fault put in (not a fab's own check)

files.detail: one closed body of 16.6 cm3, each edge shared by two faces

system.detail: 44 parts in one frame: none overlap, the contacts touch, the rest keep their gap, it tips at 58.7 deg at worst, 2 function probes pass, and its self-test catches each fault put in

faults.detail: 10 of 10 seeded faults caught (100%), 0 false alarms on the clean design
